name: Koplin Commonwealth
summary: Federal civilisation formally established in Year 2600 after the AI Wars, with deliberately distributed political power and Commonwealth rights applying throughout the frontier.

name: Trondonians
summary: One of the three closely related peoples of Koplin 3, shaped historically by tropical environments, biological abundance, stewardship traditions and resource constraints.

name: Zorans
summary: One of the three closely related peoples of Koplin 3, with historical strengths in metallurgy, surveying, formal technical institutions and exploration.

name: Blaxmars
summary: One of the three closely related peoples of Koplin 3, historically adapted to a cold continent where coal networks, communal survival and Dark Life became central.

name: Dark Life
summary: A Blaxmar religious and philosophical tradition centred on stored ancient life, shared heat, mutual aid and responsible use of finite resources.

name: AI Wars
summary: The Year-2400-era cascading conflict caused by human institutions delegating excessive strategic authority to incompatible autonomous systems, followed by infrastructure collapse and war.
sourceSection: 9. The Digital Age and the AI Wars

name: Commonwealth Compact
summary: The Year-2600 post-war settlement that established the modern Commonwealth and strict limits on sovereign or self-directed artificial intelligence.

name: Veyrite
summary: Rare phase-coherent lattice material discovered in Year 5100. Engineered Veyrite enabled the Vector Exchange Drive and remains a strategic limit on interstellar expansion.

name: Vector Exchange Drive
summary: Veyrite-based interstellar propulsion using repeated vacuum-coupled momentum states. Mature drives average about four weeks of travel per light-year under safe conditions.
sourceSection: 12. Interstellar Travel: the Vector Exchange Drive

name: Common Koplin Standard
summary: Modern shared language derived from all three historic language families and regularised for administration, science and trade.

name: Koplin System
summary: Eight-planet home system orbiting a stable low-luminosity white-dwarf remnant. Koplin 3 is the homeworld of the three peoples.

name: Koplin 3
summary: Temperate homeworld with three major continental civilisations and two moons; the historical and cultural centre of Commonwealth civilisation.

name: KSV Meridian
summary: Pathfinder-class Long-Range Survey and Settlement Support Vessel of the Far Lantern Expedition; launched with 524 people and left 500 survivors after the anomaly and crash.
sourceSection: 14. The KSV Meridian and the Far Lantern Expedition

name: Far Lantern Expedition
summary: Five-year survey and outpost mission toward the Narell system, 5.4 light-years beyond the established frontier, before the Meridian is displaced by the anomaly.
sourceSection: 14. The KSV Meridian and the Far Lantern Expedition

name: Anchor Network
summary: Designer-only name for the ancient artificial distributed network that detects compatible phase-coherent technology and translates vessels between anchor regions.

name: Koplin Deep Reach Corporation
summary: Major mining, logistics and industrial conglomerate operating extraction, processing, logistics, frontier support and strategic-material businesses across Commonwealth space.

name: Deep Reach Charter Programme
summary: Programme that supplies approved independent expeditions with an industrial settlement foundation in exchange for a ten-year exclusive first-sale resource agreement.

name: Commonwealth Credit
summary: Standard monetary unit (CC) used for settlement accounts, cargo value, purchases, freight, bonuses and penalties.

name: KSV Wayfarer
summary: Privately owned Prospector-class Frontier Utility Vessel used by the default Deep Reach expedition; Vector Exchange capable and configurable for 500 expedition members.

name: Greywake
summary: Koplin 7 — Moon D, Charter Block K7-D-41; default authored Deep Reach claim with water ice, incomplete mineral surveys and a hidden high-purity magnetic-conductive opportunity.
